note: Tinker carries a second item

turns.action: I ask the tinker what she has brought into the marsh.
turns.narration: Maren swings the brass lantern at her hip so its light falls across her coat. From an inner pocket she draws a folded map of the salt marshes, its margins thick with inked notes. She smooths it against her knee and taps a drowned village near the middle.

note: Captain gains a second ally

turns.action: I watch Captain Vance meet the dockmaster at the gantry.
turns.narration: Vance and the Halcyon guild reps nod at each other as usual, but today she crosses the deck to the dockmaster. Pell grips her forearm and swears the dock crews will stand with her against the customs fleet. Vance returns the grip and the deal is made.

turns.action: I ask Vance whether she trusts Pell.
turns.narration: Vance shrugs. "Pell has never let me down," she says, and the dockmaster grins from the far side of the gantry.

note: Detective has a scar and an older tattoo

prior_facts.subject: kane
prior_facts.object_literal: a sparrow tattoo on her wrist

turns.action: I pour the detective a drink and look her over.
turns.narration: Under the bar's yellow light, Kane pushes back her sleeve to reach for the glass, and the sparrow inked on her wrist shows. When she turns her head, a pale scar runs from her ear down along her jaw. She sees you notice and tells you a knife did it, years ago.

note: Marshal guards a second place

turns.action: I ride up and ask the marshal about his rounds.
turns.narration: Holloway leans on a hitching post across from the Dry Creek bank and tips his hat. "After dark I walk the length of main street," he says, "and the water tower behind the stables is mine to watch now as well." He points a gloved finger at the tank rising above the rooftops.

turns.action: I ask why anyone would raid a water tower.
turns.narration: "Without it, the town is dead in a week," he answers, and goes on watching the bank.

note: Nun fears a second thing

prior_facts.subject: odile
prior_facts.object_literal: the dark well in the cloister

turns.action: I find Sister Odile alone in the chapel and ask what frightens her.
turns.narration: Odile keeps her eyes off the cloister door, where the dark well waits beyond. Her voice drops as she admits that the grey moths gathering around the candles terrify her just as much. She says they only come when someone in the convent is about to die.

note: Brig restated plus new figurehead

turns.action: I walk the quay and look for the brig.
turns.narration: The harbor at Port Sable holds the Gannet at her old mooring, her ropes creaking against the pilings. Someone has fitted a new figurehead overnight, a carved heron with its beak turned to the sea. Gulls wheel around it as dockhands stare up.

note: Student restated study plus club

turns.action: I sit down beside Ines in the library.
turns.narration: Ines is bent over her star charts again, tracing the orbit of a comet with a pencil. When the bell rings she looks up and says she finally signed up for the chess club. The first meeting is Thursday after lessons.

note: Vault location unchanged, guard naps in same bank

turns.action: I ask the doorman who is on duty at Halvard Bank tonight.
turns.narration: Pike is on the night shift, the doorman tells you. He has been taking his breaks on a bench in the bank's lobby, and by two in the morning he is usually fast asleep. The doorman chuckles and says the whole street knows it.

note: Archivist moves her charts to a new room

prior_facts.subject: orsolya
prior_facts.object_literal: the star charts in the cellar vault

prior_facts.subject: orsolya
prior_facts.object_literal: the dead language of the Salt Kings

turns.action: I ask the archivist where the star charts are.
turns.narration: Orsolya leads you up a spiral stair to a glass-roofed loft. The star charts lie unrolled across a long oak table, pinned flat with brass weights. She hauled them out of the cellar last winter, she says, after the damp ruined two of them.

note: Tea vendor raises his price but keeps his apron

prior_facts.subject: brannoch
prior_facts.object_literal: recycled-water tea at two chits a cup

turns.action: I ask Brannoch for a cup of tea.
turns.narration: Brannoch taps a handwritten card taped to his cart: five chits a cup now, ever since the water ration was cut. He shrugs, smoothing the front of his blue mechanic's apron, and holds out a dented cup. Behind you the queue of dock workers grumbles but nobody leaves.

note: Detective gives away the pawn ticket

prior_facts.subject: voss
prior_facts.object_literal: the pawn ticket for the jade cat

turns.action: I ask the detective about the jade cat.
turns.narration: Voss presses the pawn ticket into your palm and closes your fingers around it. He walks out into the rain with both hands empty and his collar up, glancing once toward the harbor police boat tied at the pier.

note: Hidden rifle cache is uncovered and taken away

prior_facts.subject: barn
prior_facts.object_literal: a cache of stolen rifles under the hayloft floor

turns.action: I pry up the hayloft planks.
turns.narration: The boards come away with a shriek of nails and you lift out a long oilcloth bundle. Forty rifles lie in the open air at last, and the deputy loads them onto a wagon bound for the county jail's evidence room. Rain drums on the tin roof overhead.

note: Robotics club gets a new captain, same meeting room

turns.action: I ask who runs the club this term.
turns.narration: Priya leans on a crutch and lifts the captain's whistle from around her neck. She loops it over Dmitri's head with a crooked smile; her ankle will keep her off the practice floor until spring. Dmitri blows one nervous note, and the club cheers from the folding chairs in room 214.

note: Ship lost at dice

turns.action: I watch the dice game in the tavern.
turns.narration: Ferrin stares at the two bones on the table, then lays the brig's deed beside the pot with a trembling hand. Quill the smuggler sweeps it into his coat and grins. By the time the lamp burns low, the Gull's Promise belongs to Quill, cracked mainmast and all.

note: Thief swaps her disguise

prior_facts.subject: ines
prior_facts.object_literal: a lockpick roll sewn into her boot

turns.action: I follow Ines into the linen closet.
turns.narration: Ines strips off the guard's tunic and stuffs it behind a stack of sheets. She pulls a grey maid's dress over her head, tugs a white cap down over her braid, and nods at you. The boot with the lockpick roll stays on her foot.

note: Ferry guard dies

prior_facts.subject: gorm
prior_facts.object_literal: a driftwood cabin on the east bank

turns.action: I look for the ferryman at the landing.
turns.narration: The landing is empty and the ferry bobs untended against its rope. Two fishermen carry a blanket-wrapped shape up from the shallows: Old Gorm, drowned in last night's flood. His driftwood cabin on the east bank stands dark.

note: Guild breaks with the Duke

prior_facts.subject: guild
prior_facts.object_literal: a hall above the fish market

turns.action: I deliver the Duke's letter to the guild master.
turns.narration: The guild master reads three lines, then tears the Duke's seal in half and drops it on the floor. She declares the guild at war with Vael and orders the hall's shutters barred. Downstairs, fishmongers shout over the morning catch, unaware.

note: Scientist abandons one study for another

turns.action: I ask Dr. Yuen what she is working on.
turns.narration: Yuen powers down the signal receivers one by one and drapes a cloth over the console. She is done with the pulsar, she says, and turns every instrument toward the derelict ship drifting off the port bow. Its hull alloys are all she wants to measure now.

note: Haunted doll moved to the attic

turns.action: I go to the nursery to check on the doll.
turns.narration: The cradle is empty and the rocking horse sits still. You find the doll upstairs, propped against a trunk in the dusty attic, its painted glass eyes catching your lantern. Nobody in the house admits to carrying it there.

note: Boatman's fare changes

turns.action: I offer to sing for passage across the river.
turns.narration: Harl shakes his head and spits over the gunwale. Songs were fine last week, he says, but the river is high and he wants the brass lantern at your belt instead. He holds out his hand and waits.

note: Abbess hands over the reliquary key

prior_facts.subject: maudlin
prior_facts.object_literal: the reliquary key in her sleeve

turns.action: I ask the abbess to open the reliquary for me.
turns.narration: The abbess presses an iron key into Brother Cael's hand and tells him the reliquary is his to open now. Her sleeve hangs empty and light as she turns toward the chapel door.

note: Heist time lock runs out

prior_facts.subject: vault
prior_facts.object_literal: a time lock set to dawn

turns.action: I wait by the vault door as the clock crawls.
turns.narration: Dawn light bleeds through the basement grating just as the brass dial clicks over to zero. The vault groans, the bolts retract, and the great door swings open on a wall of safety deposit boxes. Somewhere upstairs a clerk unlocks the front doors.

note: Outlaw trades badge for bandana

turns.action: I watch Dutch Calloway at the edge of town.
turns.narration: Dutch Calloway unpins the tin badge and flicks it into the dust. He ties a black bandana across his face and swings back onto his grey mare, Biscuit. By the time the sheriff looks up, he is only a plume of dust on the ridge.

note: Engineer relocates to the bridge

prior_facts.subject: ilves
prior_facts.object_literal: the cargo bay of the Lantern Ark

turns.action: I look for the engineer.
turns.narration: The cargo bay is silent, his workbench cold. You find Ilves on the bridge, curled in the navigator's chair with a blanket and the magnetic spanner in his lap. He mutters that the bridge bunks are the only warm ones left since the heating failed below.

note: Coven crowns a new leader

prior_facts.subject: coven
prior_facts.object_literal: the standing stones above the mill

turns.action: I watch the coven's gathering at the stones.
turns.narration: Hesper Crowe unclasps her black cloak and lays it over the shoulders of the miller's daughter Isolde. The coven bows as one, and Hesper steps back into the ring as a plain member. Wind howls through the standing stones above the mill.

note: Clerk withholds a stamp but acquires a key

turns.action: I hand the clerk my cargo manifest and wait.
turns.narration: Pell did not stamp the manifest. He slid it back across the desk with a sigh and a smudged thumbprint on the corner. A spare key to the bonded cage now hangs from his waistcoat chain.

note: Folk rule about a door plus a lantern handed over

turns.action: I ask the sexton about the east door of the abbey.
turns.narration: Nobody ever opens the east door after dark, Brother Quill mutters, glancing at the bell rope. He presses an iron lantern with a green shutter into your hands and walks you back toward the cloister.

note: Warned of a consequence that has not happened

turns.action: I reach toward the clock face and ask the groundskeeper what it does.
turns.narration: Old Maren catches your sleeve before your fingers land. If you touch that clock, the gate will open early, she warns. The pendulum is wrapped in red thread, and the hands sit ten minutes slow.

note: Failed repair attempt plus a new item worn

turns.action: I ask Tove whether the reactor is back.
turns.narration: Tove failed to restart the reactor; the core coughs, shudders, and falls dark again. She pushes a welder's visor up onto her forehead and wipes soot from her cheek.

note: Guard admits a weakness and carries a whistle

turns.action: I ask the guard what he will do if a prisoner reaches the water.
turns.narration: Dax squints at the black water lapping the jetty. He cannot swim, he admits, and a knotted rope round his belt is the only plan he has. A brass whistle hangs from his collar.

note: Caretaker declines to go somewhere but hands over a key

turns.action: I ask Mrs. Orne to take me down to the cellar.
turns.narration: Mrs. Orne refused to go down into the cellar, standing rigid at the top of the steps with her lamp trembling. Instead she presses a tarnished silver key into your palm and says the pantry will serve you better.

note: Merchant refuses to sell an item

turns.action: I slide a handful of coins across the stall and reach for the compass.
turns.narration: Oska pushes the coins back across the counter with one finger. She tucks the compass under its velvet cloth and shakes her head, smiling without warmth.

note: Hatch refuses to unseal

turns.action: I punch the release code into the panel beside the hatch.
turns.narration: The panel chirps twice and flashes amber. The hatch does not budge, and the seals groan against the pressure waiting behind them.

note: Lady hands back a ring offered for a new alliance

turns.action: I kneel and offer her the pearl ring of House Varn.
turns.narration: Lady Isolde studies the ring for a long moment, then closes my fingers back around it. Her oath belongs to Corvane, she says gently, and the banner behind her does not stir.

note: Principal turns down a request to take over the lab

turns.action: I ask Principal Hale to put me in charge of the chemistry lab.
turns.narration: Hale folds his hands and shakes his head slowly. Ms. Okafor signed the key log herself and she keeps the lab, he says, sliding your application form back across the desk.

note: Captain refuses to sail and crew stop a rash act

turns.action: I order the crew to cast off for Skellig.
turns.narration: Brask grips the wheel and refuses, and the anchor chain stays taut. The harbor pilot has barred the bay with a line of floats, and the captain growls that no ship leaves Port Verrin until the fog lifts.

turns.action: I draw my knife and try to cut the anchor line myself.
turns.narration: Two deckhands pin my wrist before the blade touches the rope. The Gull rocks gently in her berth while the fog presses against the rigging.
